title: Toast controller with duplicate merge
desc: Colored toast notifications (Red/Green templates) that merge duplicates into "(xN)", pulse on repeat, pop in/out with UIScale, and preload their sounds.

title: Success/Error toast manager
desc: Tiny Success/Error toast module: clones a template, recolors stroke + gradient by type, fades in, plays a sound, fades out after 2s; never yields the caller.

title: Floating reward pop-ups
desc: "+$123" reward pop-ups at a random spot near screen centre: pop-size + fade in, float up + fade out, with sound; driven by server RemoteEvents.

title: Stacking item alerts
desc: Item alert feed that merges repeated "+N Item" alerts into one running total instead of spamming new rows, with optional chat system message.

title: Elastic alert feed
desc: Classic bottom-up alert feed: max N rows, elastic slide-in, older alerts pushed up, slow fade out and cleanup.

title: Global announcements + rarity spawn banners
desc: Builds its own UI in code: admin announcements (avatar headshot + name + text) stacked at top of screen, rarity-gradient "egg spawned" announcements with a sliding gradient, plus a small redeem-code window.

title: Yielding message / yes-no dialog
desc: BIG Games framework dialog: one call shows an OK message, a Yes/No question, or a 2-option choice and yields until the player answers (with gamepad support).

title: Server-or-client dialog service
desc: Shared Dialog module usable from server or client: GetChoice yields for the player's yes/no answer (per-player queue, 60s timeout), ShowMessage / ShowMessageAll for one-button messages.

title: Dialog box client (PC + gamepad)
desc: Client side of the pizza-place dialog: queues dialogs, fills title/message/button texts, swaps to A/B gamepad buttons on console, sends the choice back.

title: Custom ProximityPrompt UI
desc: Custom-style ProximityPrompt UI: billboard per prompt, shows key name on PC or tap icon on mobile, tap/click/hold all forward to InputHoldBegin/End.

title: Zone enter banner
desc: Area title banner: when the player enters a tagged zone part, a CanvasGroup banner (zone name, gradient, recommended speed) slides in for 3s then fades.

title: Full-screen danger alert
desc: Full-screen "RUN!" warning driven by a player attribute: red flash, pulsing gradient screen edges, heartbeat-scaled text; fades out when the attribute clears.

title: HUD badge pulse
desc: Attention badge on a HUD button: every few seconds two red rings ripple out while the badge pops and wiggles like a bell.

title: Notification with timer bar
desc: Notification with a filler wipe-in and a shrinking timer bar showing time left; templates per "Mode", callable from server via RemoteEvent.

title: Sliding notification list
desc: Good/Neutral/Bad notifications with colored side bar and sound; new ones slide in at the top and push older ones down, then slide out left. NOTE: the original has "if true then return end" at the top (disabled in game).

title: Spring-animated notifications
desc: Framework notification service: respects a player "Notifications" setting, plays optional audio, spring-animates UIScale in/out (Spr), callable from server or client.

title: Moderator announcement banner
desc: Simple moderator announcement banner: clone template, fade in title/text/name over 2s, hold 6s, fade out.

title: Cross-server announce command
desc: Server admin command that announces to this server and to every other server via a messaging hub, skipping its own JobId to avoid double messages.

title: Core SendNotification with button
desc: Uses the built-in StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification") with a Join button + BindableFunction callback to prompt group join every few minutes if not a member.

title: Favorite / join-group nudge
desc: Favorite / join-group nudge shown when using a shop prompt: native favorite dialog (AvatarEditorService) first, then a small group card; 5-minute cooldown if ignored.

title: Gamepass buy button
desc: World SurfaceGui gamepass buy button: hover/press tweens, anti double-prompt, listens to PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished and flips to "Purchased".

title: Floating cash and error text
desc: Floating "+N coins!" / "+N skips!" text with random drift and rotation, plus red error text from client (BindableEvent) or server (RemoteEvent).

title: Toast queue (pattern)
desc: Stacking toasts with Success/Error/Info/Warning styles, duplicate merge with (xN), max visible, auto-dismiss, optional sounds.

title: Confirm dialog (pattern)
desc: Yielding modal: Ask() returns true/false, Message() and Choose(); queued, Enter/Escape and gamepad A/B, optional timeout.

title: Announcer (pattern)
desc: Server-to-client announcement banners (player, server, or all servers via MessagingService) with queued display and optional avatar headshot.

title: Purchase prompt wrapper (pattern)
desc: Yielding wrapper for game pass / developer product prompts with anti-double-prompt lock, timeout, pending callback and ownership cache.
